deal_types.name: Wholesale Assignment Route
deal_types.description: Standard double-ended purchase agreement with assignment of equitable interest.

milestone_task_chain.step: Open Escrow with Title Company
Verify Seller EMD Wire Confirmation
Dispatch Inspector / Photo Walkthrough
Hand off Cleared Deal Packet to Sub-Account 03 (Dispo)
Review Executed Assignment & Title Wire
Sign Closing Statement & Collect Fee

deal_types.name: Novation Agreement Route
deal_types.description: Seller authorizes property renovation and MLS listing with guaranteed net proceeds payout.

milestone_task_chain.step: Execute Notarized Novation & POA with Seller
Contractor Bid & Material Procurement Walkthrough
Execute Cosmetics / Repairs (14-Day Sprint)
Professional Photography & MLS Syndication
Accept Retail Buyer Contract & Open Retail Escrow
Dual Settlement Closing (Seller Net + Spread Payout)

deal_types.name: Creative Finance (Subject-To / Seller Carry)
deal_types.description: Acquiring subject to existing debt or structured seller financing wrap note.

milestone_task_chain.step: Order Formal Mortgage Payoff & Reinstatement Quote
Verify Underlying PITI, Interest Rate & Escrow Balance
Submit Escrow Servicing Packet to Weststar / EscrowServicing
Update Homeowners Insurance with Loss Payee Named
Execute Warranty Deed & Record Title Transfer

deal_types.name: Retail MLS Listing Route
deal_types.description: Licensed brokerage listing route for maximum market value disposition.

milestone_task_chain.step: Sign Brokerage Listing Documents
Schedule 3D Virtual Tour & Drone Media
Publish Live to Regional MLS & Real-Time Syndication
Review Offer Matrix with Seller
Escrow Closing & Commission Payout

deal_types.name: Joint Venture (JV) Co-Wholesale Route
deal_types.description: Partner deal collaboration with defined profit split schedules.

milestone_task_chain.step: Sign JV Co-Wholesaling Agreement (50/50 Split)
Confirm Escrow Title Instructions with Partner
Syndicate Deal Packet to Shared Buyer Database
Final Closing & Wire Fee Split Disbursement
